searches.query: simulated bifurcation benchmark classical optimization critique; digital annealing industrial scheduling; tensor-network optimization
squeezing sensor gains, distributed quantum sensing, entanglement network metrology
Rydberg RF sensor compared with antenna; quantum battery superabsorption and critical perspectives
spin squeezing atomic magnetometry; atom interferometry gravimetry; Rydberg radar synthetic aperture
simulated bifurcation vs quantum annealing scaling rebuttal; transport robot scheduling case study
digital annealer QUBO benchmarks; supply-chain logistics classical and annealing solvers
topological and collective sensing experiments; Rydberg radar ranging; quantum battery scaling limits

candidates.title: High-performance combinatorial optimization based on classical mechanics
candidates.selection_reason: Early simulated-bifurcation anchor; large-scale performance claims and comparator choices are relevant to separating algorithmic from hardware advantage.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check benchmark instances, competing classical solvers, tuning fairness, hardware/runtime accounting, and industrial transfer.

candidates.title: Benchmark of quantum-inspired heuristic solvers for quadratic unconstrained binary optimization
candidates.selection_reason: Direct multi-solver comparison across real-problem-library and hard synthetic QUBO classes; reports different winners by problem family.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Inspect tuning, time limits, hardware differences, statistical replication, and how representative MQLib instances are of operational work.

candidates.title: An Optimization Case Study for solving a Transport Robot Scheduling Problem on Quantum-Hybrid and Quantum-Inspired Hardware
candidates.selection_reason: Application-led transport robot schedule study comparing digital annealing, quantum-hybrid solving, and Gurobi with end-to-end runtime and solution quality.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Compare formulations and stopping criteria, validate the Gurobi comparison, and inspect whether apparent runtime gains retain equal solution quality.

candidates.title: Closing the Quantum-Classical Scaling Gap in Approximate Optimization
candidates.selection_reason: Direct rebuttal to an approximate-optimization scaling-advantage claim, substituting GPU simulated bifurcation for the chosen classical baseline.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Reproduce identical instances and epsilon targets; assess GPU/CPU accounting, tuning parity, benchmark-size extrapolation, and preprint status.

candidates.title: Limitations of tensor-network approaches for optimization and sampling: A comparison against quantum and classical Ising machines
candidates.selection_reason: A useful negative/limitation study comparing tensor-network solvers against D-Wave and simulated bifurcation on hardware-shaped graphs, with geometry-dependent results.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check tensor contraction settings and GPU resources, instance selection, quality/diversity metrics, and whether limits apply beyond the tested graph geometries.

candidates.title: Performance of quantum annealing inspired algorithms for combinatorial optimization problems
candidates.selection_reason: Comparative benchmark of simulated coherent Ising and bifurcation variants on Max-Cut, including solver-specific strengths and weaknesses.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Determine whether the compared algorithms are tuned equivalently and how graph families, exactness, and time-to-solution definitions shape rankings.

candidates.title: A Quantum-Inspired Tensor Network Algorithm for Constrained Combinatorial Optimization Problems
candidates.selection_reason: Relevant tensor-network optimization method with explicit constraint handling; candidate for feasibility and scaling assessment.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Establish tested instance sizes, baselines and cost of mapping/evolution; distinguish method proposal from demonstrated operational performance.

candidates.title: GEO: Enhancing Combinatorial Optimization with Classical and Quantum Generative Models
candidates.selection_reason: Tensor-network generative optimization applied to portfolio instances and compared with several established optimizers; useful positive claim with real-world-shaped data.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Inspect data leakage, instance construction, tuning and compute budgets, and whether a quantum-inspired model adds value over classical GEO.

candidates.title: Supply Chain Logistics with Quantum and Classical Annealing Algorithms
candidates.selection_reason: Large real supply-chain routing context with an iterative decomposition and classical simulated-annealing comparison; useful for application realism and workflow limits.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Separate the classical workflow contribution from quantum benefit, inspect demand simplifications and simulation validation, and compare against production-grade routing baselines.

candidates.title: A Reality Check on Quantum Optimisation: Evidence from an Industrial Case Study
candidates.selection_reason: Recent job-shop case study spans QPU, Digital Annealer, and exact/classical methods, including validity and end-to-end measures.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Treat as preprint; inspect workload realism, exact-solver limits, formulation-specific effects, platform timing, and the authors' stated threats to validity.

candidates.title: Simulated Bifurcation Quantum Annealing
candidates.selection_reason: Recent proposed stronger classical baseline extends simulated bifurcation with inter-replica interactions; may be relevant to sparse and rugged cases.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Inspect which comparisons are independently reproducible, parameter-search budget, class of instances, and whether the claimed improvement generalizes.

candidates.title: Accuracy and performance evaluation of quantum, classical and hybrid solvers for the Max-Cut problem
candidates.access: publisher page surfaced; full text availability unclear
candidates.selection_reason: Recent cross-solver Max-Cut comparison includes simulated bifurcation and state-of-the-art classical methods; potential independent benchmark check.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check instance generation, stopping budgets, statistical reporting, and whether conclusions are limited to the tested graph families.

candidates.title: Field Demonstration of Distributed Quantum Sensing without Post-Selection
candidates.selection_reason: Established experimental anchor: a real-space separated sensing pair, unconditional comparison to shot-noise limit, and field/fiber configurations.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check total system losses, whether the shown sensing task generalizes to dynamic environmental signals, and cost/latency of distributing entanglement.

candidates.title: Distributed quantum sensing of multiple phases with fewer photons
candidates.selection_reason: Experimental multiphase network sensing over fiber with fewer photons than unknown phases; relevant to distributed sensing, though lab phase estimation is not surveillance sensing.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check resource counting, phase-estimation estimator details, loss/noise scaling, and separation of fiber-spool distance from field deployment.

candidates.title: Distributed quantum sensing with a mode-entangled network of spin-squeezed atomic states
candidates.selection_reason: Atomic network with nonlocal entanglement; proposed clock and interferometer protocols connect distributed sensing with timing/navigation use cases.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Verify article version/date and characterize whether demonstration is experimental network sensing versus protocol application to simulated/configured tasks; account for node and communication noise.

candidates.title: Quantum-enhanced metrology with network states
candidates.access: open preprint; journal landing page surfaced
candidates.selection_reason: Important theoretical boundary result: limits for local network states and conditions for attaining Heisenberg scaling.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check the precise network/resource assumptions, probabilistic success costs, and applicability to realistic loss and communication constraints.

candidates.title: Spin squeezing of 1011 atoms by prediction and retrodiction measurements
candidates.access: publisher abstract surfaced; full text access unclear
candidates.selection_reason: Large-ensemble experimental spin-squeezing/magnetometry anchor predating the recent distributed-network advances.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Compare metrological gain with total measurement and preparation overhead, bandwidth and dynamic-field limits, and practical sensor noise.

candidates.title: Locking of intrinsic spin squeezed state in Earth-field-range magnetometry
candidates.selection_reason: Recent magnetometry work explicitly targets Earth-field operation, making it more application-proximate than abstract SQL beating.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Inspect absolute sensitivity, bandwidth, calibration, robustness, and comparison against mature classical magnetometers under matched conditions.

candidates.title: Measuring gravitational attraction with a lattice atom interferometer
candidates.access: publisher abstract surfaced; full text access unclear
candidates.selection_reason: Experimental gravity measurement anchor for atom interferometry; offers a grounded comparison point for emerging sensor claims.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check systematic errors, instrument footprint, averaging and environmental isolation, and which gravity/nav applications are inferred rather than demonstrated.

candidates.title: Performance of antenna-based and Rydberg quantum RF sensors in the electrically small regime
candidates.access: publisher abstract surfaced; full text access unclear
candidates.selection_reason: Direct comparison with conventional antenna sensors is a valuable corrective to broad Rydberg sensitivity claims.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check equal aperture, bandwidth, noise and readout assumptions; separate present sensor performance from idealized limits.

candidates.title: Synthetic Aperture RF Reception using Rydberg Atoms
candidates.access: open NIST record and paper link
candidates.selection_reason: Primary technical demonstration of Rydberg sensing in a synthetic aperture with phase/magnitude readout and image reconstruction.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Assess whether motion-scanned aperture is operationally practical, resolution and calibration against conventional arrays, and signal/environment constraints.

candidates.title: Atomic superheterodyne receiver based on microwave-dressed Rydberg spectroscopy
candidates.selection_reason: Mature experimental Rydberg RF receiver anchor with phase- and frequency-resolved sensing, prior to recent radar-oriented demonstrations.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check claimed sensitivity versus receiver bandwidth, integration time, calibration, conventional RF receivers, and environmental deployment.

candidates.title: Quantum-enhanced Electrometer based on Microwave-dressed Rydberg Atoms
candidates.selection_reason: Reports entanglement-assisted sensitivity improvement for Rydberg electrometry; relevant positive result to pair with classical antenna comparison.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Verify journal version and matched shot-noise baseline, quantify loss/readout assumptions, and distinguish quantum gain from practical sensor gain.

candidates.title: Radar Ranging Using Rydberg Atomic Homodyne Receiver
candidates.selection_reason: Recent experimental Rydberg homodyne radar/ranging architecture with direct relevance to sensing and navigation; merits critical but current review.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Validate target/range setup, conventional receiver comparison, emitted power and signal processing assumptions, and whether demonstration supports operational radar claims.

candidates.title: Quantum battery based on superabsorption
candidates.selection_reason: Theoretical superabsorption proposal connects collective enhancement to quantum-battery charging; include as a phenomena candidate, not an application claim.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check assumptions about charger coherence, scaling resources, decoherence, charge extraction and whether the predicted speedup is operationally useful.

candidates.title: Superabsorption in an organic microcavity: Toward a quantum battery
candidates.selection_reason: Experimental collective superabsorption anchor, with ultrafast optical spectroscopy in a molecular microcavity.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Keep demonstrated optical absorption/storage dynamics separate from an engineered battery; test charge extraction, lifetime, scale, and device-level energy accounting.

candidates.title: Superextensive electrical power from a quantum battery
candidates.selection_reason: Very recent experimental full charge/discharge-cycle claim and collective scaling result; a promising advance that needs careful device-level interpretation.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Inspect molecule-count range, control devices, electrical output and efficiency, reproducibility/data access, and the authors' own stated scaling-up questions.

candidates.title: Hamiltonian k-Locality is the Key Resource for Powerful Quantum Battery Charging
candidates.selection_reason: Theory challenges entanglement-first battery narratives and foregrounds locality and per-cell energy as resource constraints.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check definitions and comparison classes behind power bounds, relation to earlier results, and practical relevance to experimentally observed devices.

candidates.title: Superextensive charging power in the absence of global operations
candidates.selection_reason: Recent counterweight identifying resource conditions for superextensive quantum battery power; accepted in 2026 and directly useful for evaluating scaling claims.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check proof assumptions, publication/version status, consistency with battery experiments, and how g-extensiveness is physically realized.

candidates.title: Enhanced sensitivity via non-Hermitian topology
candidates.selection_reason: A possible collective/topological sensing lead, but the reported amplification is explicitly classical in this experimental setup; retain as a comparator against quantum-labelled sensitivity claims.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Confirm noise-adjusted estimator sensitivity and distinguish amplified response from information gain or quantum advantage; assess physical relevance to defence sensing.

candidates.title: Collective quantum enhancement in critical quantum sensing
candidates.selection_reason: Recent collective critical sensing theory predicts a network enhancement and explicitly analyzes finite-nonlinearity saturation; application relevance remains speculative.
candidates.deeper_reviewer_should_test: Check resource counting, saturation bounds, noise robustness, experimental feasibility, and whether the metric gain survives resource-matched comparisons.
